summary: An audio effects firmware for dub: the FM-1 acts as a USB sound card and Bluetooth receiver, and its keys and knobs play a siren, tape echo, DJ filter and isolator over whatever audio comes in. No sequencer or synths.
features: Siren with five LFO types, gated from the last black key
Tape echo with wow, flutter and soft-clipped repeats
Bipolar DJ filter and four-band isolator with key-operated kills
2-in/2-out USB audio; Bluetooth receiver with SBC, AAC and aptX
Mixer, five-band EQ, limiter, meters and spectrum display
Needs the community m-bootloader, installed with M-Flasher
